0022600115.text: The Toronto Raptors are 1-0 and sit second in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and fourth in the East, while the Minnesota Timberwolves are also 1-0, third in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and seventh in the West. Toronto is 1-0 at home and Minnesota is 1-0 on the road, and the teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, following a 2025-26 season series in which the Raptors lost 0-2, most recently 115-107 in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026. Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture) are out for Toronto, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) is out for Minnesota.
